_note: Two kinds of thing. `commission` is the studio's real work and is priced by js/commission.js, because the model is multiplicative and the shared additive priceLine() cannot express it. `edition` pieces are ordinary products priced by shared/core/pricing.js. Everything else in the stack — dates, capacity, cart, checkout — is the same for both.

_techniques: Add-ons in the catalogue sense, but they are the studio's actual vocabulary. Each carries its own price and its own days, and the ambition level caps how many of them a brief can hold — a Clean brief with six techniques on it is not a clean brief.

products.name: A commission
products.subtitle: Priced on the page, firm for fourteen days
products.description: Tell us the size, how far you want it taken, and which of our techniques belong on it. The number moves as you go, and it is the number — not a band, not a range, not an email in a week.

products.name: Edition No.1
products.subtitle: Black sesame, brown butter, burnt honey
products.description: The first thing we repeated. Sesame ground on the day, brown butter in the sponge, honey taken further than is comfortable.

products.name: Edition No.2
products.subtitle: Olive oil, lemon, bay
products.description: No butter in it at all. Bay steeped in the oil overnight, which is the whole trick and took us a year to get right.

products.name: Edition No.3
products.subtitle: Buckwheat, pear, crème fraîche
products.description: Autumn only, because the pears have to be the right ones. Buckwheat makes it darker and a little savoury.

products.name: Offcuts
products.subtitle: What came off the commissions this week
products.description: Levelling a tier produces a lot of cake. It is the same cake, in the wrong shape, for a third of the price. We never know what is in the box until Friday.
